I’ve often thought about what one more student in every class would mean. Depending on where you teach, a ServSafe class brings in $120 to $180 per student. One extra student per class can easily add hundreds of dollars a month to your business.

We all know this. That’s why instructors spend money on:

Websites
SEO
Google Ads
Facebook Ads
Direct mail
Local marketing

All for the chance to reach one more student.
